meta.title: Data Center Sponsor Decision Studio
meta.recalculation: Base case sourced from cached workbook; modified scenarios use screening sensitivities.

roles.accountable: Strategy, customer/capital assembly, developer/FM appointments, budget and changes, investor reporting.
roles.exclusions: Daily technical operation; contractor self-performance; automatic completion guarantee.

roles.accountable: Holds site rights, infrastructure assets, power contract and facility delivery/O&M agreements; pays approved costs.
roles.exclusions: GPU ownership where external partner owns IT.

roles.accountable: Site feasibility, EOR/GC coordination, permits, utilities, reconciled budget, schedule, procurement and readiness.
roles.exclusions: Ownership of site; providing capital; post-COD FM unless separately contracted; customer credit.

roles.accountable: Constructs electrical/cooling/physical works, manages subs, safety, procurement, testing and correction of defects.
roles.exclusions: Investor governance; independent certification of own work; indefinite O&M.

roles.accountable: Stamped design, load/rack/PUE criteria, permitting and system interface requirements.
roles.exclusions: Owner's investment underwriting; guaranteed utility energization.

roles.accountable: Independent cost/scope review, progress verification, change evaluation, lender draw monitoring.
Integrated systems testing, failover/load testing, evidence of performance and acceptance recommendations.
roles.exclusions: Replacement for EOR design or contractor warranties.

roles.accountable: 24/7 staffing, power/cooling maintenance, safety, monitoring, vendors, monthly budgets/invoices and incident reporting.
roles.exclusions: Compute SLA/software; financing; major replacement capex or developer defects unless expressly included.

roles.accountable: Cluster provisioning, networking/storage, GPU support, security, customer compute SLA and billing interfaces.
roles.exclusions: Base-building maintenance unless expressly appointed to FM role.

roles.accountable: Procures/owns/finances equipment, warranties, refresh/resale and supply chain. External in Partner Colo.
roles.exclusions: Free capital; ownership of facility; automatic obligation to cover sponsor deficits.

roles.accountable: Agrees technical load, capacity payments, acceptance tests, credit support and term.
roles.exclusions: Sponsor financing or guarantee of occupancy beyond contract.

roles.accountable: Firm capacity, interconnection scope, delivery date, tariff/energy terms and diverse fiber.
roles.exclusions: Facility uptime beyond contracted point; developer completion.

roles.accountable: Credit approval, staged funding, collateral, covenants and draw requirements.
Title, leasehold protections, contracting, entity/tax analysis, insurance and regulatory diligence.
roles.exclusions: Commercial viability guarantee or a substitute for engineering.

diligence.requirement: Approve ProjectCo ownership, sponsor duties and investor economics
Execute assignable long-term lease with lender protections and options
Purchase contract, title, survey, valuation and acquisition loan
Environmental, geotechnical, flood/storm and building condition reports
Firm utility capacity, interconnection scope and energization date
All-in delivered power tariff/PPA, demand and curtailment obligations
Freeze customer brief: IT MW, rack kW, cooling, redundancy, storage/fabric
Validate comparable delivered projects, financial capacity and subcontracting
Reconciled developer/GC proposal with inclusions, exclusions and contingencies
Execute priced construction/delivery contract and completion support
Agree certified payment schedule, stored-material security and retainage
Critical path, procurement lead times, permits and commissioning plan
Executed anchor capacity/compute agreement and customer credit review
Firm OEM quote, complete BOM, warranty and delivery commitments
Equipment lender term sheet, amortization and security package
Dedicated compute operator scope, staffing and customer SLA
External GPU operator signs facility commitment and proves hardware funding
Facility/acquisition loan commitment and draw conditions
Binding LP/strategic/sponsor equity commitments and future-call obligations
FM bid with roster, direct costs, management fee and exclusions
Execute separate FM contract with limits, reporting, audit and step-in
Approve funded overhaul/refresh reserves and retention policy
Insurance binders, local tax assessment and exemption eligibility
Appoint independent commissioning authority and agree pass/fail tests
Approve bank accounts, draw certification and monthly payment authority
IC approves downside cases, funding, residual risk and final notice to proceed

sources.text: R01 | CBRE Data Center Operations | Critical facility operations, monitoring, energy optimization and project delivery are identifiable service scopes | https://www.cbre.com/services/property-types/data-center/data-center-operations | Read 7 Oct 2026 | Service description, not fee quote or proof that a particular developer is qualified.

R02 | AIA G702/G703 guidance | Progress payment documentation, schedule of values, stored materials, retainage and change orders | https://learn.aiacontracts.com/articles/gc-pay-apps-g702-and-g703/ | Read 7 Oct 2026 | Contract process reference. Texas counsel and lenders must approve actual terms/security.

R03 | AIA facility management documents | Facility-management agreements are a separate contracting category | https://aiacontracts.com/documents?projectType=facility-management | Read 7 Oct 2026 | Not a substitute for a mission-critical O&M SLA or legal review.

R04 | NVIDIA DGX B300 reference | Original workbook cites 8 GPUs / approximately 14 kW reference system | https://www.nvidia.com/en-us/data-center/dgx-b300/ | Legacy technical reference | Not revalidated as a procurement specification for modeled 2029 operation.

R05 | NVIDIA NVL72 reference architecture | Original workbook cites 72 GPUs / 142 kW compute rack reference | https://docs.nvidia.com/enterprise-reference-architectures/nvl72-ai-factory/latest/components.html | Legacy technical reference | Additional network/storage power and actual OEM hardware configuration require engineering.
